legality.basis: regulation mark (赛制标记) printed on the card, plus the eight basic Energy cards
legality.note: The product code (商品编号, e.g. CS5aC) is NOT the regulation mark; the official notice says so explicitly.

construction.official_wording: 每个玩家可使用60张卡牌组成一套"卡组"（必须刚好60张，多于60少于60皆不可）

construction.rule: at most 4 cards with the same name
construction.official_wording: 相同名称的卡牌在1套卡组中最多可以放入4张。

construction.rule: basic Energy is exempt from the 4-copy limit
construction.official_wording: 1套卡组中可放入的基本能量卡数量没有限制。
每个构筑卡组都必须放入至少1张的基础宝可梦

construction.rule: at most 1 card with the same name for 棱镜之星 (Prism Star)
construction.official_wording: 同名的【棱镜之星】卡牌只能在卡组里放置一张

sources.role: official card lookup lives only in the WeChat mini-program 宝可梦卡牌会员

open_gaps: No per-set official table mapping mainland product codes (CS..C/CBB..C) to card numbers was found; the official card lookup is a WeChat mini-program with no HTTP surface.
Official Simplified Chinese wording for the ACE SPEC and 光辉 (Radiant) one-per-deck limits was not found; do not assert those limits without a source.
Kartu text and print numbers for individual cards could not be sourced from a primary, machine-readable channel in this session (see docs/data/card-image-resource.md).

reprint_provision.basis: At the frozen date the official rules allowed named Sun&Moon / Sword&Shield reprints in the standard format with the newest wording applied.
